test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Communities**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct word to fill in the blank is "communities". • "**Communities**" is a noun that refers to a group of people living in the same area or sharing a common interest. (एक ही क्षेत्र में रहने वाले या समान हित साझा करने वाले लोगों का समूह) • **Example**: *Communities often come together to support local initiatives and projects.* • The sentence is talking about a group of people, so "**communities**" is the most appropriate option. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Mobs**: This refers to a disorderly or violent crowd. (उच्छृंखल या हिंसक भीड़) • **People**: This is a general term for human beings. (मनुष्य के लिए एक सामान्य शब्द) • **Conditions**: This refers to the state of something. (किसी चीज़ की अवस्था) 161:T7f4, The correct answer is: **Famine**
